mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) reduces market uncertainty, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 1% triggers a tightening cycle, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1% in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 1%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a robust demand-supply cycle, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the next month
regime_hint: expanding economy with balanced demand and supply
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies increase concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market expansion with rising unemployment rates below 8.5%, low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 230), S&P 500 forward returns are positively correlated over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market expansion with low inflation
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 8.5% and CPIAUCSL < 230.1.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) above 133,300 signals weakening labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 133,300 in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite PAYEMS crossing above 133,300.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 230) combined with low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates a dual easing environment, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both CPIAUCSL < 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and INDPRO falling), S&P 500 forward returns are negatively correlated over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates reduce growth prospects.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising above 1% and INDPRO falling below 96.8.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (GDPC1 > 13564.5) combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO > 96.82) creates a virtuous cycle, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the next month
regime_hint: expanding economy with robust demand and supply
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase concurrently.
